actionCenter.NewSession:
({dataCenter, actionCenter, globalUtils}, eventParams) => {
   dataCenter.showNewDesign = !dataCenter.showNewDesign
   const { tabName , frequency, frequencyRenge, frequencyRangeUnit  } = dataCenter
   const { AntennaName, BackingName, ArrayName } = tabName
   const name = `${AntennaName}Fm`
   dataCenter.noNewDesign = {
      frequency, 
      frequencyRenge, 
      frequencyRangeUnit,
      tabName,
      ArrayParams: dataCenter.ArrayName,
      AntennaParams: dataCenter.name,
      BackingParams: BackingName === "None" ? BackingName : dataCenter.BackingName,
      show_base64: dataCenter.show_base64,
      impedance_base64: dataCenter.impedance_base64,
      SParameter_base64: dataCenter.SParameter_base64
   };
   dataCenter.tabName = {
      "ArrayName": "Linear",
  		"AntennaName": "Dipole",
  		"BackingName": "None"
   }
  dataCenter.disableApply = false
}
actionCenter.accept:
({dataCenter, actionCenter, globalUtils}, eventParams) => {
  const { tabName } = dataCenter
  const { AntennaName, BackingName, ArrayName } = tabName
  const reqParams = actionCenter.defaultParams(`${ArrayName}${AntennaName}${BackingName}`)
  const name = `${AntennaName}Fm`
   if(BackingName === "None"){
    const { frequency, frequencyRenge, frequencyRangeUnit } = reqParams
    dataCenter.frequency = frequency
    dataCenter.frequencyRenge = frequencyRenge
    dataCenter.frequencyRangeUnit = frequencyRangeUnit
    dataCenter.name = reqParams[name]
    dataCenter.noNewDesign = {
      frequency, 
      frequencyRenge, 
      frequencyRangeUnit,
      tabName,
      ArrayParams: dataCenter.ArrayName,
      AntennaParams: dataCenter.name,
      BackingParams: tabName.BackingName === "None" ? tabName.BackingName : dataCenter[tabName.BackingName],
      show_base64: dataCenter.show_base64,
      impedance_base64: dataCenter.impedance_base64,
      SParameter_base64: dataCenter.SParameter_base64
   }
  }else{  
    const { frequency, frequencyRenge, frequencyRangeUnit } = reqParams[AntennaName]
    dataCenter.frequency = frequency
    dataCenter.frequencyRenge = frequencyRenge
    dataCenter.frequencyRangeUnit = frequencyRangeUnit
    dataCenter.name = reqParams[AntennaName][name]
    const { [AntennaName]: removed, ...newObj } = reqParams
    dataCenter.BackingName = newObj
    dataCenter.noNewDesign = {
      frequency, 
      frequencyRenge, 
      frequencyRangeUnit,
      tabName,
      ArrayParams: dataCenter.ArrayName,
      AntennaParams: dataCenter.name,
      BackingParams: tabName.BackingName === "None" ? tabName.BackingName : dataCenter.BackingName,
      show_base64: dataCenter.show_base64,
      impedance_base64: dataCenter.impedance_base64,
      SParameter_base64: dataCenter.SParameter_base64
   }
  }
  dataCenter.disableApply = true
  dataCenter.disableBtn = false
  const elementMap = actionCenter.defaultParams("Element")
  dataCenter.Linear.Element = elementMap[AntennaName]
  dataCenter.RectangularArr.Element = elementMap[AntennaName]
  dataCenter.showNewDesign = !dataCenter.showNewDesign
}
actionCenter.cancel:
({dataCenter, actionCenter, globalUtils}, eventParams) => {
  const { noNewDesign } = dataCenter
  const { isEmpty } = globalUtils
  if(!isEmpty(noNewDesign)){
    const { frequency, frequencyRenge, frequencyRangeUnit, tabName, show_base64, impedance_base64, SParameter_base64 } = noNewDesign
    dataCenter.frequency = frequency
    dataCenter.frequencyRenge = frequencyRenge
    dataCenter.frequencyRangeUnit = frequencyRangeUnit
    dataCenter.tabName = tabName
    dataCenter.show_base64 = show_base64
    dataCenter.impedance_base64 = impedance_base64
    dataCenter.SParameter_base64 = SParameter_base64
  }
  dataCenter.showNewDesign = !dataCenter.showNewDesign
  dataCenter.disableApply = true
}
actionCenter.init_using:
async ({dataCenter, actionCenter, globalUtils}, eventParams) => {
  const { post, getFilePath } = globalUtils
  dataCenter.showLoading = true
  dataCenter.allMessage = "初始化中..."
  const lastCode = `
    using TyAntenna
    using TyPlot
    using Base64
    include(raw"./customShow.jl")
    include(raw"./design.jl")
  `
  console.log("init lastCode:", lastCode )
  await post({
      key: "initUsing", 
      command: "excute", 
      code: lastCode,
  })
  dataCenter.showLoading = false
  dataCenter.allMessage = "就绪"
}
actionCenter.saveSession:
({dataCenter, globalUtils}, eventParams) => {
  const { generateReport } = globalUtils
  const { tabName, frequency, frequencyRenge, frequencyRangeUnit, show_base64, impedance_base64, SParameter_base64, showOtherPlot, disableBtn } = dataCenter
  if(disableBtn) return
  const name = `${tabName.AntennaName}Fm`
  let param = {
    frequency, 
    frequencyRenge, 
    frequencyRangeUnit,
    tabName,
    show_base64,
    impedance_base64,
    SParameter_base64,
    showOtherPlot,
    ArrayParams: dataCenter.tabName.ArrayName,
    AntennaParams: dataCenter.name,
    BackingParams: tabName.BackingName === "None" ? tabName.BackingName : dataCenter[tabName.BackingName]
  }
  console.log('saveSession', param)
  generateReport(param, "json")
}
